_about: Route allow-list for the manifest gate (A-49). Every public, employee-token and machine-token route, and every write with no permission or entitlement check, is named here with a one-line reason. An entry with "finding" is a known gap tracked in FIX_CHECKLIST.md: the gate passes it but reports it, and fails once the route is guarded so the entry is removed. Checked by tenant-platform-upgrade-2026-10-23/scripts/inventory-routes.mjs --check (CI) and server/src/__tests__/routeManifest.test.ts.
